name: Impact Widgets for Elementor
author: impactaddons

sections.description:
Impact Widgets for Elementor is built for designers and agencies that need flexible Elementor widgets with clean output and full style controls.

Included in 1.0.0:
– Advanced Heading widget
– Subtitle, title, description, and separator controls
– Responsive typography and spacing controls
– Wrapper style controls (padding, margin, background, border, radius, shadow)

Included in 1.1.0:
– Advanced Button widget
– 6 button style presets (Background, Bordered, Accent Overlay, Badge Content, Ribbon Tag, Downloadable)
– Separate configuration layer for button style mapping and sanitization
– Advanced Dual Button widget with 4 dual-button presets (Dual Button, Image & Border, Button Gradient, Border & Hover)

Included in 1.2.0:
– Animated Text widget
– Content controls for before/animated/after text and animation effects
– Style controls for typography, animated highlight area, cursor, and wrapper
– Dedicated frontend CSS and JS animation assets

Included in 1.3.0:
– Advanced Icon / Info Box widget
– Soft Card design preset (other presets will be added incrementally)
– Content controls for icon, title, description, optional button, alignment, and icon position
– Style controls for box, icon, title, description, and button

Included in 1.3.2:
– Icon / Info List widget
– Circle Info widget
– List, timeline, card, badge, and circular information layouts
sections.installation:
1. Upload the impact-widgets-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin plugins page.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and search for the included widgets in the Impact Widgets for Elementor category.
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor Pro?

No. The plugin works with the free Elementor plugin.

What happens if Elementor is deactivated?

The plugin shows an admin notice and safely stops loading widgets.
